_README: PadSplit's applicant list has no export/API and no history — it only shows CURRENT status + the date of the LAST change, overwriting the earlier date every time someone advances. So we keep our own history here. Workflow: whenever you check PadSplit's applicant list, paste the current full list to Claude. Claude matches each person by name against 'people' below, appends a new history entry ONLY when their status actually changed since last time (dated the day we noticed — that's the best precision possible without PadSplit exposing true transition dates), and adds anyone new as a new person. The more often you paste an update, the more accurate the stage-transition dates get. Occasionally PadSplit shows an implausible old date (2023/2024) for someone whose neighbors in the list are all recent — when that happens, estimate the real date from the surrounding entries and record BOTH the estimate (as observedOn) and the original bogus date (in that entry's 'note' field). If a future paste shows that same bogus date again for that person, check for an existing 'note' first — it's the known issue, not a new anomaly to re-derive.
_statusValues: Valid statuses, in pipeline order: registered -> applying -> approved (screened) -> move_in (booked a room) -> then either booking_fee_waived (moved into OUR room - the goal, instant) or pending -> paid (moved into ANOTHER host's room: 'pending' means PadSplit's 14-day reward-confirmation clock is running post-move-in; after 14 days it becomes paid, $250 payout). IMPORTANT: 'pending' only ever means this post-move-in reward wait -- PadSplit does not use it for an earlier 'application under review' stage, despite where it might look like it sits in a raw applicant list.
